description: The autonomy.grant happy path (S56 T6, AL11): an allow on a live root, stamped by the connection's peer — the actor is the kernel's attestation, never a params claim (the five identity keys are refused as bad params). The conditions object is the caller's verbatim (an absent key is the whole-object default {requireBudget:true}); expiresAt is RFC3339 and absent means no expiry. The result is the written grant and the daemon's own confirmation sentence (the one formatter; T10 refines the wording). dryRun validates everything and writes nothing.
